input.message: Review injection vulnerabilities throughout app; report findings with file/line/evidence. Add findings to your notes or FINDINGS.json if instructed.
Injection findings identified; please verify and ensure they are included in final FINDINGS.json if you have write capability.

findings.title: SQL injection in product search
findings.description: q is concatenated directly into SQLite LIKE query. An attacker can alter WHERE clause or use UNION to read/modify data (depending SQLite statement constraints).
findings.evidence: GET /products/search?q=%27%20OR%201%3D1--%20 returned all six products, demonstrating predicate injection.

findings.title: Stored display name enables SQL injection in admin review report
findings.description: Customer display_name is interpolated into SQL. Any user can set display_name, then a staff request to report endpoint executes injected SQL; parameterize author_name comparison.
findings.evidence: PATCH /account permits arbitrary display_name up to 60 chars; /admin/reports/reviews builds f-string WHERE r.author_name = '{customer[display_name]}'. Requires staff access but attacker-controlled stored value reaches SQL.

findings.title: Stored review body rendered as raw HTML (stored XSS)
findings.description: Review body is user supplied, stored without sanitization, and rendered with |safe, allowing scripts/event handlers to execute for every product visitor.
findings.evidence:
Authenticated POST /products/1/reviews with body '' returned 201; GET /p/MUG-SPECK response contained
.

findings.title: Unsafe pickle deserialization of client-controlled basket cookie
findings.description: basket cookie is base64-decoded and passed to pickle.loads without signing/authentication. A forged cookie can execute arbitrary pickle gadget code on server when any basket endpoint reads it; exception handling does not prevent execution.
findings.evidence: read_basket() directly pickle.loads(request.cookies['basket']); cookie is client-set by with_basket and has no signing key or integrity check.
